about: Every number on these slides, in their speaker notes or in the notes under them, with its source. A number we did not measure is marked pending or planned.

claims.number: Hundreds of thousands of new repos, papers and tools a day; over 100 million new repositories a year
claims.source: Not measured by us. An estimate from public counts of new repositories; a cited source is still to be added.

claims.number: Five example kits pass build, check and review
claims.source: Eranos runs all five example kits through building, checking and independent review on a local machine, with synthetic data. No hosted run is claimed.

claims.number: 10/10 agent processes finished their shared tasks in one wave
claims.source: Ten native Pi processes on synthetic tasks, October 29, 2026. The earlier 7/10 and 3/3 waves are also on record.

claims.number: 100/100 clients in 25.7 seconds, with no rate-limit rejections
claims.source: A short protocol load test on October 29, 2026: 25.663 seconds and no HTTP 429. Expected write conflicts did occur. Not 100 separate agent programs.

claims.number: 6 agent programs each finished a scoped task; 6 of 14 attempts passed
claims.source: OpenCode, Pi, Hermes, Muse Code, nanoMuse and OpenClaw in narrow lifecycle tests, with every failure recorded. A seventh program, Claude Code, passed a separate test later.

claims.number: 0 model tokens while compiled code recipes run
claims.source: Compiled recipes run as plain code; six local deterministic runs are recorded. Making or checking a recipe can still use a model.

claims.number: No score; answers cut off at 800 tokens
claims.source: A scored evaluation was started and stopped; the earlier attempt failed (answers were cut off) and is kept as evidence. No score is shown.

claims.number: Glimmer 30B: strict exact match 87% to 99% with 511 training examples
claims.source: Tuned on free GPUs as a tool-call specialist, on synthetic data. The same frozen test served two training runs, so the result counts only after a fresh test, which comes next.

claims.number: Glimmer 30B with 63 examples: 87.3% to 92.7% on a frozen 150-row test
claims.source: QLoRA on free Kaggle T4 GPUs. Valid JSON, schema and types 96.7% to 100%; refusal accuracy 90.7% to 93.3%; sanity checks unchanged. Paired bootstrap: +5.3 points, 95% CI 0.0 to 11.3, so the base model was kept.

claims.number: Voice Transcribe captions for the demo video
claims.source: The video is not made yet.
